name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.33.0: A sparkline, and the sample ring behind it; Break a battery trend across external power, and keep the line legible under the cursor.
changelog.v2.32.1: Draw the clock from a seam, so a screenshot is reproducible.
changelog.v2.32.0: Slide between screens, from a route derived off the nav; Let the tab strip decide a transition's direction, both ways round.
changelog.v2.31.0: Add the slider, and say which numbers are a scale; Place a slider's stops after the fill, and refuse anything under its bottom stop.
changelog.v2.30.0: Add the screen progress bar and the banner.
